title: Bevel Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Blender 4.5 LTS Manual; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: The modifier is a non-destructive alternative to the Edit Mode Bevel operation
Limit methods include None, Angle, Weight attribute, and Vertex Group
Clamp Overlap restricts bevel width but is not documented as a complete topology-quality guarantee
Harden Normals preserves surrounding flat-face normals by creating custom normal data; Face Strength is designed for a following Weighted Normal modifier with Face Influence

On uniform cylinder and taper fixtures, Harden Normals restored curved-side analytic error to the unbeveled baseline; on an uneven equal-count circle it preserved the baseline's existing 5-degree topology error rather than concealing it
candidate_principles: Use Angle limiting when coplanar triangulation edges should not be beveled
Choose segment count from visual requirements because evaluated density rises quickly
Inspect minimum edge length and corner quality even when Clamp Overlap is enabled
Apply or explicitly account for non-uniform object scale before judging world-space bevel width

title: Weighted Normal Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Blender 4.5-era latest Manual; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: Weighted Normal creates custom per-corner normals using face area, corner angle, or their product
Keep Sharp preserves sharp-edge boundaries and Face Influence consumes weak, medium, or strong face strengths
On a matched Blender 5.2 flat-panel fixture, Bevel Face Strength AFFECTED followed by Weighted Normal Face Influence reduced maximum large-panel corner-normal error from 10.5605 degrees to zero

On uniform radial/taper fixtures the same stack kept curved-side analytic error below 0.024 degrees, but on an uneven equal-count 12-sided circle it increased side error from a 5.0-degree unbeveled baseline to 9.9988 degrees
candidate_principles: Place Weighted Normal after the modifier that authors the face strengths it consumes
Use custom normals to correct interpolation on suitable flat panels, never as a substitute for geometric or topological repair
Inspect curved regions independently and reject face-area weighting when uneven panel distribution increases analytic or visual error

title: Curved Bevel Normal-Policy and Uneven-Cage Control
creator: interactive-agent-blender

direct_observations: Twelve live, unapplied variants compare four policies across uniform and uneven cylinders plus a taper
Plain smooth Bevel bends cap normals by 8.4464 to 8.4823 degrees; Harden Normals restores all cap and side measurements to the unbeveled baseline
The uneven equal-count 12-sided circle has a 5.0-degree baseline side error; Face Strength plus Weighted Normal increases it to 9.9988 degrees
A fresh Blender process verifies all modifier stacks, flags, topology, sampling contracts, and numeric boundaries
limitations: Controlled low-sided radial/taper fixtures rather than an unfamiliar reference asset
No Subdivision Surface, arbitrary double curvature, runtime telemetry, or human visual acceptance

direct_observations: The pending gate validates against the exact machine audit and construction plan SHA-256 digests
The decision recorder rejects non-human authority, stale evidence, contradictory authorization flags, missing correction notes, malformed timestamps, and wrong gate identity
A valid approval is scoped to REVERSIBLE_PRIMARY_BLOCKOUT_ONLY while a correction keeps modeling unauthorized
limitations: No human decision has been supplied or retained
Reviewer identity is an explicit claim rather than cryptographic proof
This validates authorization integrity, not reference quality or modeling ability
